description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆公募基金的年化收益率（比涨跌幅更契合实际盈利情况）汇总数据（考虑分红再投入）。可按基金代码批量查询，返回最新数据日期、近1月/3月/6月/1年/2年/3年/5年/10年收益率及成立以来年化收益率等数据。当用户想了解某公募基金或者对比某些公募基金在不同周期下的收益率的统计数据，对比不同基金的收益高低时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain annualized return summary data for A-share funds (considering dividend reinvestment). Supports batch query by fund code, returning fields such as latest data date and annualized returns for periods of 1 month/3 months/6 months/1 year/2 years/3 years/5 years/10 years, as well as annualized return since inception. Call this interface when users want to understand the return performance of a fund across different periods or compare returns across different funds.
